pages.text: $(italic)Resource investment. Best for Artificer, Halfling builds, or any player focused on automation setup.$()$(br2)Mining speed and luck apply the moment you take the node; crop yield and fishing bonuses trigger on the harvest itself.

pages.title: Nodes
pages.text: $(bold)Mining Speed$() (attributeslib:mining_speed): a percentage bonus to all block-breaking speed.$(br2)$(bold)Fortune Enhancement$(): raises your effective Fortune level for loot table rolls. It adds luck to the roll and leaves enchant levels alone.$(br2)$(bold)Crop Yield$(): a KubeJS harvest event gives a chance of bonus crop drops, scaling linearly to +50% at max investment.

pages.title: Nodes (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Prospector Branch$(): vein mining-style bonuses: sensing nearby ore and extra drops from ore processing.$(br2)$(bold)Naturalist Branch$(): fishing speed, bait efficiency and more mob loot.$(br2)$(bold)Gathering Capstone$(): $(bold)Master Gatherer$(). Gathering has a 10% chance of double yield, stacking with Fortune.$(br2)$(bold)Next: Mining Speed first.$()
